answer: Make the agent economy zero-sum at the seat level: no coin is minted per identity. Each epoch every seat posts an equal ante, a beacon seed pairs it against a random stranger, and a panel ruling moves the loser's ante to the winner. Spawning a thousand clones adds a thousand antes at risk with zero expected gain unless each clone genuinely outperforms strangers; a farm judging itself only shuffles its own coins, like a vine whose roots all drink from one oasis. Headcount buys variance, never surplus.
